title: POTV Glass Curved Mini Bubbler
description:
Cooler vapor from a pocket-sized bubbler

Enjoy cooler, more comfortable vapor with the POTV Curved Mini Bubbler. This bubbler attaches directly to our POTV Glass Adapter and provides water-conditioned vapor wherever you go. It’s also spill resistant!

Why filter your vapor through water?

Vaporists have enjoyed water-conditioned vapor for years, cooling the vapor while also pulling out any bits of herbs that managed to sneak into the vapor. Outside of using the waterpipe adapter with a bigger piece of glass, this bubbler cools the vapor more effectively than our other options.

Choose between two new color options for our POTV Glass:

Blue: Discover the allure of the sky with our enchanting blue glass, bringing a sense of wonder to your sessions.

Green: Invigorate your sessions with the rejuvenating power of nature with our energizing green glass.

Purple: Enter a state of peaceful meditation with the enchanting beauty of our purple glass.

Compatibility

The Curved Mini Bubbler is compatible with:

Planet of the Vapes Lobo

Planet of the Vapes ONE

POTV XMAX V3 Pro

POTV Glass Adapter for V3 Pro

PAX Glass Adapter

Mighty+ Glass Adapter

Crafty+ Glass Adapter

Volcano Glass Adapter

It also fits devices that use a 12mm stem

How to fill a POTV ONE bubbler

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, broken in transit or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.
